The teachers of old stated that (1–1), being of the present, is not obtained. What they actually meant | was that present states are all included in conascence condition. Investigation Chapter

As the states of this Triplet belong to the three periods of time, all the 24 conditions are expounded. As with the Arisen Triplet, the conditions which are concerned with present states only have only 1 answer (3–3). For proximity and the other conditions which have past conditioning states and present conditioned states, there is the answer (1–3); for kamma condition, which is concerned with both past and present states, there is the answer (1–3) with past states and (3–3) with present states. The text should be referred to in order to know how the conditions are expounded. The Negative conditions are like those of the Arisen Triplet dealt with above.
